_comment: Copy to .docket-surfaces.json and describe what THIS project is building.
The console adds the Docket viewer, the questions page and the capture
dashboard by itself — every Docket project has those. This file is only for
the project's own surfaces: the website, the app, the tool, the thing.
Each surface is probed before it is shown, in this order: this server, then
each also_local base in turn, then live. Whichever answers first is where
the link goes, and the card says which one that was. A surface nothing is
carrying shows its start command rather than a link that fails.
tone: blue | purple | cyan | green | amber | gray  — a reader finds a card
by colour before reading its title, so keep them stable once chosen.
lede: These run on this machine. They reach services with this machine's own login and read files that exist nowhere else, so none of them is on the live site.
